notes: Lease ran 6/5/2023-5/31/2024 and ended on schedule; all rent and fees through May 2024 paid, no open rent. On 06/27/2024 the PM pulled 1,351.35 from the tenant (make ready 1,256.35 + fee 95.00); the tenant charged it back on 07/05/2024, reversing the payment and triggering the 85.00 NSF fee, so net open is 1,436.35. The itemization letter is dated 27 June 2024 but already lists the 07/05 NSF fee. Make Ready is a lump sum with no vendor invoice in the folder (only an external link), so category is a best fit and cannot be split. Tenants paid a monthly Administrative Pet Fee (120) and had a pet processing fee, but nothing in the documents attributes any charge to pets (move-out report: Odor satisfactory). SD program is the RentWerx Preferred Resident Program ($33/mo = $28 insurance + $5 admin, in lieu of deposit); application mentions Obligo screening, not treated as another provider since the claim is under a Corgi policy. Ledger shows RBP billed at 41.00 from Feb 2024 (59.00 earlier).
